label: First-customer report journey

builder.change: Completed the first-customer journey: concrete cold-entry copy, visible founder and AI disclosure, source-safe report rendering, independent rewrites and questions, count-accurate guidance, honest free-report completion, and a consistent five-more-for-$29 decision.
builder.claim: A cold visitor receives a more trustworthy, specific, and actionable complete free report than production, with no invented facts and a clear optional paid next step on desktop and mobile.

critic.rationale: Blind reviewers preferred the candidate in all twelve cases, but fresh source critics found thirty source-fidelity defects across eleven cases. Public-reference trust cleared only one of twelve cases, while specificity and actionability each cleared eight of twelve, so the zero-invention and nine-case bars were not met.
critic.remainingGap: Recover complete source lines, fail unsafe rewrites closed, remove causal, ownership, scope, number, and absence overclaims, and rewrite loaded questions as non-presuppositional prompts before recapturing a new iteration.

baselineStatement: Production and candidate use the same twelve synthetic resumes and the same historical generated report payloads; this iteration isolates the candidate renderer, entry journey, and paid-decision changes against the deployed production renderer, then judges the real captured outputs without competitor accounts or customer data.
